## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file located at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. This file was automatically loaded by Python on startup and deliberately patched the markupsafe library by:

1. Overriding `_MarkupEscapeHelper.__int__` to raise `ValueError`
2. Overriding `_MarkupEscapeHelper.__float__` to raise `ValueError`
3. Overriding `EscapeFormatter.format_field` to raise `ValueError` for numeric formatting

This disruption caused the string interpolation tests with numeric format specifiers (`%i` and `%.2f`) to fail because the `__int__` and `__float__` methods were being called during formatting operations.

The fix was to remove the `sitecustomize.py` file, which restored the normal behavior of the markupsafe library. All 78 tests now pass.
